comment: Frozen per-cell expectations for Paper III Table 'full-noisy'. Cells are frozen one at a time as the campaign fills; the validation gate skips 'pending' cells. Counts are the measured aggregates of the recorded runs; case-level outcomes at fixed code are platform- and scheduling-sensitive (knife-edge population), so reruns reproduce totals at the +-few-case level, not per-case marks. Arm membership is recorded per capsule in campaign_manifest.json:arm_signature, read from the runs themselves rather than inferred from directory names. Note that the sealed audit partition for the statistical decisions is drawn from the full dataset and is much larger than the training split. Structural verdicts come from scripts/_structural_verdict.py, shared with the factorized-search oracle audit so both benchmark tables use one definition.

timing.note: per-problem wall time, one thread per problem, campaign run with JOBS=8 so timings include contention
